up: Retrieve distinct target descriptions (pref_name from target_dictionary) for assays where the assay organism is 'Caenorhabditis elegans' and which have associated activity records. Join target_dictionary with assays on tid, and join assays with activities on assay_id to ensure only targets with at least one activity are included. Filter strictly on assays.assay_organism = 'Caenorhabditis elegans'. Return only the distinct pref_name column.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name FROM assays a JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid WHERE a.assay_organism = 'Caenorhabditis elegans'
